segments.comment: Independent wintty.c new_status_window() witness: a debug Tourist with statushilites:30 and a gold/up/green rule wishes for 200 gold, so $: is shown green, then sets statuslines to 3 through #optionsfull. tty_preference_update('statuslines') rebuilds the status window and calls botl.c status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY), whose gu.update_all evaluates every field with chg = 0 and clears its timer, so the redrawn gold has no highlight.
